scripts.test:offline: for f in tests/owned-runtime.test.mjs tests/runtime-lock.test.mjs tests/lifecycle-gate.test.mjs tests/sdk-signal-ownership.blocker.test.mjs tests/bundle-smoke.test.mjs tests/build-metadata.test.mjs tests/production-security.test.mjs tests/conversation-page.test.mjs tests/media-store.test.mjs tests/media-response.test.mjs tests/push-store.test.mjs tests/push-store-hardening.test.mjs tests/push-browser-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/sw-push.test.mjs tests/push-delivery.test.mjs tests/events.test.mjs tests/sse-e2e.test.mjs tests/static-hosting.test.mjs tests/pwa-contract.test.mjs tests/web-contract.test.mjs web/tests/api.test.ts web/tests/events.test.ts web/tests/router-store.test.ts web/tests/components.test.tsx web/tests/markdown.test.tsx web/tests/voice.test.ts web/tests/read-gate.test.ts; do echo "# $f"; node --import tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:loopback: for f in tests/receipts.test.mjs tests/state-dir-isolation.test.mjs tests/package-runtime-assets.test.mjs tests/rest-e2e.test.mjs; do echo "# $f"; node --import tsx "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:startup && npm run test:offline && npm run test:loopback && npm run test:browser
